items.unit: PLN/machine (average selling price, ex-works, all clamp sizes; derived)
items.basis: Haitian International FY2025: injection-moulding-machine revenue RMB 16,897.3 m ÷ ~56,800 machines sold = RMB 297,488 per machine. Haitian's own release gives group revenue RMB 17,733.2 m ≈ EUR 2,240.6 m, i.e. RMB 7.9145/EUR → EUR 37,588 per machine × 4.374 = 164,409 PLN
items.notes: COMPANY ANNUAL REPORT, derived ASP. It is a mix average over every clamp size Haitian sells (Mars servo-hydraulic dominates; ~57% of revenue is sold in China at Chinese prices), ex-works, machine only — not installed, not per tonnage, and not a European price. Useful only as a floor/cross-check for imm-200t…imm-400t; it cannot be split by tonnage from the published figures (no units per series). Page not opened (egress proxy blocks fetches); figures as quoted by the search result for these URLs.

Vimetco Extrusion (ALRO group, Slatina, Romania): EUR 10 m investment = acquisition and installation of an automated 7-inch aluminium extrusion line supplied by Presezzi Extrusion (profiles up to 60 m at 50 m/min, +11,000 t/yr); × 4.374 = 43,740,000 PLN
items.date: project started March 2021, first billet 2022 (company announcement; 2021–22 prices)
items.notes: COMPANY ANNOUNCEMENT of an investment value (not a list price); EU buyer in a CEE country, same supply market as Poland. The press force is not stated — a 7-inch container matches the library's 1,800 t line (7" container); scope beyond 'acquisition and installation of the line' (building, dies) not stated. 2021 price, not escalated. Book implied capex 14,676,480 PLN — evidence is ~3× the book. Pages not opened (egress proxy); figures as quoted by the search results.

items.basis: Soure, Portugal (2024): investment of about EUR 25 m including two 2,800 t aluminium extrusion lines → ≤ EUR 12.5 m per line × 4.374 = 54,675,000 PLN. Cross-check: Vitex (New Hampshire, US, ~2021) first phase US$12 m for a 2,750-ton Presezzi press × 3.849 = 46,188,000 PLN
items.notes: Trade-press investment values: the Soure EUR 25 m may include the building and other plant, so per-line is an upper bound; Vitex 'first phase' scope not stated. Both are 2,750–2,800 t (slightly above 2,500 t). Book implied capex 22,014,720 PLN — evidence is ~2.1–2.5× the book. Larger-press cross-checks: Grupa Kęty raised Extrusions capex by 188 m zł (ESPI, July 2021) for a production-and-warehouse hall plus a 4,000 t press line (a 2,000 t press to go in the same hall was already budgeted) — https://comparic.pl/grupa-kety-realizuje-strategie-dotyczaca-nakladow-inwestycyjnych/ ; Alcomet (Bulgaria) 40 MN Presezzi press, first extrusion 10 Mar 2026, within a EUR 70 m programme (https://www.alcircle.com/news/first-extrusion-achieved-on-alcomet-ads-newly-installed-40-mn-presezzi-press-117614). Pages not opened (egress proxy).

notes: 28 web searches used (cap 30). WebFetch and curl to every host were refused by the egress proxy (ENOTFOUND / CONNECT 403), so every figure is as quoted by the search engine's summary of the cited URL — verify against the page before use.
Book implied capex = buildupPln.financeCost ÷ 2% from current-poland-book.json, the same method round 1 used.

Polish procurement awards (Baza Konkurencyjności) were found only as NOTICES (Improdex IMM ≥200 t + robot; MARDOM profile line; Świebodzin powder line) — the search tool does not reach the award documents with the net value. A person with a browser could read those three notices' 'informacja o wyborze' pages.
No IMM maker publishes units by clamp size; the Haitian ASP is a mix average and cannot replace per-tonnage capex.
Strongest finding: aluminium extrusion lines — two independent EU investment values put a 7-inch / ~1,800 t line at ~43.7 m PLN and a ~2,800 t line at ≤54.7 m PLN, 2–3× the book's UK × 0.72 capital.
